acceptance_criteria.statement: Agreed functional and integration tests pass against the target.
acceptance_criteria.verification_method: Test results attached to the validation report

acceptance_criteria.statement: Performance is within the agreed tolerance of the recorded baseline.
acceptance_criteria.verification_method: Baseline comparison in the validation report

acceptance_criteria.statement: Security configuration, identity, network isolation, and auditing match policy.
acceptance_criteria.verification_method: Security checks in the validation report

acceptance_criteria.statement: The business owner accepts the outcome against the engagement success measures.
acceptance_criteria.verification_method: Approval artifact recorded in the ledger

communication_plan: Notify affected application owners and the service desk at freeze start.
Post status at each checkpoint inside the window.
Announce the go / no-go decision explicitly, including a no-go.
Confirm completion or rollback, with the reason, to all stakeholders.
cutover.execution_window: An agreed low-traffic window, sized from the measured rehearsal.
cutover.freeze_start: T-2h relative to the agreed window start

go_no_go_criteria.statement: No blocking validation check has failed and none is un-run.
Replication lag has reached zero and stayed there for the agreed period.
go_no_go_criteria.verification_method: Replication monitoring output captured as evidence

go_no_go_criteria.statement: The rollback path is rehearsed, staffed, and available for the window.
go_no_go_criteria.verification_method: Rehearsal record plus named on-call roster

go_no_go_criteria.statement: All five owner roles have recorded an approval for this cutover.
go_no_go_criteria.verification_method: Approval ledger for the migration plan

cutover.replication_method: Continuous replication drained to zero lag before the switch.

phases.name: Prepare
phases.objective: Establish readiness and close every entry criterion before anything moves.

tasks.description: Verify subscription, identity, network, private connectivity, DNS, policy, logging, backup, and disaster-recovery ownership for the target scope.
tasks.title: Confirm landing zone readiness

tasks.description: Record query latency, throughput, concurrency, and error rates over a representative period. Without this baseline, no post-migration comparison can be made and no regression can be proven.
tasks.title: Capture the source performance and behaviour baseline

tasks.description: Walk the dependency list with each application owner and record confirmation. Unconfirmed consumers are the usual cause of a failed cutover.
tasks.title: Confirm application dependencies with their owners

phases.name: Build
phases.objective: Stand up the target and make the application able to use it.

tasks.description: Deploy the target configuration to a non-production subscription using infrastructure as code, reviewing the what-if output before applying.
tasks.rollback_note: Delete the non-production resource group. No production system is affected at this step.
tasks.title: Provision the non-production target environment

tasks.description: Run conversion tooling, then hand-remediate every object the tooling could not convert. A conversion percentage is tool output, not evidence of equivalent behaviour.
tasks.title: Convert schema and database code

tasks.description: Update connection handling, retry logic, driver versions, and any code that relied on instance-scoped behaviour that the target does not offer.
tasks.title: Remediate the application for the target

phases.name: Migrate
phases.objective: Move data into the non-production target and rehearse the cutover.

tasks.description: Perform an initial data load and start continuous replication.
tasks.rollback_note: Stop replication and drop the non-production target databases.
tasks.title: Seed the non-production target

tasks.description: Run the full cutover sequence against non-production and measure the actual downtime. Until this produces a number, downtime expectations stay at short-planned rather than near-zero.
tasks.rollback_note: Restore the non-production target from the pre-rehearsal snapshot.
tasks.title: Rehearse the cutover and measure the window

tasks.description: Execute the documented rollback against non-production and confirm the source returns to service within the decision window.
tasks.rollback_note: This task is the rollback rehearsal; failure means the plan is not ready.
tasks.title: Rehearse the rollback

phases.name: Validate
phases.objective: Produce the evidence a go / no-go decision will rest on.

tasks.description: Run every check in the validation plan and record the observed value against its tolerance. A check with no recorded observation counts as not run, not as a pass.
tasks.title: Execute the validation plan

tasks.description: Review the validation report with all five approval roles. A blocking failure forces a no-go; an un-run blocking check forbids a go.
tasks.title: Review validation evidence and decide go / no-go

phases.name: Cutover
phases.objective: Move production traffic, with an explicit decision point before doing so.

tasks.description: Deploy the reviewed infrastructure to production after a what-if review. Requires the recorded approval of all five owner roles.
tasks.rollback_note: Leave the source serving traffic and remove the unused production target. No traffic has moved at this point.
tasks.title: Provision the production target

tasks.description: Apply the write freeze, drain replication, switch the application, and verify the smoke tests inside the agreed window.
tasks.rollback_note: Invoke the documented rollback: restore application configuration to the source, confirm write availability, and reconcile any data written to the target during the window.
tasks.title: Execute the cutover

phases.name: Stabilize
phases.objective: Hold the workload under observation before anything is decommissioned.

tasks.description: Monitor performance, errors, and cost against baseline for the agreed period, with the rollback path still available throughout.
tasks.title: Run the hypercare period

tasks.description: Only after hypercare completes and business acceptance is recorded. This repository never decommissions anything; the decision and the execution are both human.
tasks.title: Decide whether to decommission the source

rollback.data_reconciliation_note: Writes accepted by the target during the window must be identified, extracted, and replayed or formally written off with business-owner agreement. Rollback is not complete until this is settled.
rollback.evidence_preservation: Before rolling back, capture logs, metrics, failed test output, and replication state. Rolling back without evidence guarantees the same failure next attempt.
rollback.maximum_decision_window: The rollback decision is taken no later than the agreed window minus the measured rollback duration.
rollback.method: Return application configuration to the source, confirm write availability, then reconcile anything written to the target during the window.

triggers.statement: Post-cutover performance regresses beyond the agreed tolerance against baseline.
triggers.verification_method: Baseline comparison from the validation report

triggers.statement: Any blocking application integration test fails after cutover.
triggers.verification_method: Integration test results captured as evidence

triggers.statement: Data reconciliation is incomplete or shows an unexplained difference.
The cutover exceeds the agreed window with no clear path to completion.
